entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: Kalnor, a Junktown guard.
entries.source_text: Kalnor, a Junktown guard.

entries.text: 卡尔诺，一个迦克镇的守卫。
entries.source_text: 卡尔诺，一个迦克镇的守卫。

entries.text: You'd better watch yourself here.
entries.source_text: You'd better watch yourself here.

entries.text: 你在这里最好注意点。
entries.source_text: 你在这里最好注意点。

entries.text: This isn't a good town to get in trouble in.
entries.source_text: This isn't a good town to get in trouble in.

entries.text: 这可不是一个能让你到处惹麻烦的地方。
entries.source_text: 这可不是一个能让你到处惹麻烦的地方。

entries.text: Behave, and we won't have to get nasty.
entries.source_text: Behave, and we won't have to get nasty.

entries.source_text: 规矩点，这样我也不用来硬的了。

entries.text: You're OK.
entries.source_text: You're OK.

entries.text: 你没什么问题。
entries.source_text: 你没什么问题。

entries.text: Keep up the good work.
entries.source_text: Keep up the good work.

entries.text: 做得不错，继续这样。
entries.source_text: 做得不错，继续这样。

entries.text: Nice day, isn't it?
entries.source_text: Nice day, isn't it?

entries.text: 不错的一天，不是吗？
entries.source_text: 不错的一天，不是吗？

entries.text: This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on# our good side.
entries.source_text:
This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on
# our good side.

entries.text: 这里是迦克镇。落脚的好地方，只要你别干坏事。
entries.source_text: 这里是迦克镇。落脚的好地方，只要你别干坏事。

entries.text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.
entries.source_text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.

entries.text: 小心吉斯莫和他的走狗。
entries.source_text: 小心吉斯莫和他的走狗。

entries.text: I like my boss.
entries.source_text: I like my boss.

entries.text: 我喜欢我的老大。
entries.source_text: 我喜欢我的老大。

entries.text: You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place, friend, and we# want to keep it that way.
entries.source_text:
You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place, friend, and we
# want to keep it that way.

entries.text: 你最好把那东西收起来。迦克镇是一个友好的地方，朋友，并且我们想保持如此。
entries.source_text: 你最好把那东西收起来。迦克镇是一个友好的地方，朋友，并且我们想保持如此。

entries.text: Put what away?
entries.source_text: Put what away?

entries.text: 把什么收起来？
entries.source_text: 把什么收起来？

entries.text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.
entries.source_text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.

entries.text: 不用你来告诉我怎么做，白痴。
entries.source_text: 不用你来告诉我怎么做，白痴。

entries.text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?
entries.source_text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?

entries.text: 听起来不错。顺便问一下，本地对于武器是如何规定的？
entries.source_text: 听起来不错。顺便问一下，本地对于武器是如何规定的？

entries.text: Uh, oh.
entries.source_text: Uh, oh.

entries.text: 嗯，哦。
entries.source_text: 嗯，哦。

entries.text: Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd# better damn well keep them in your holster.
entries.source_text:
Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd
# better damn well keep them in your holster.

entries.text: 你的武器，呆瓜。基利安不会把你的武器没收，但是你最好把这些武器在皮套上收好。
entries.source_text: 你的武器，呆瓜。基利安不会把你的武器没收，但是你最好把这些武器在皮套上收好。

entries.text: Oh, sorry.
entries.source_text: Oh, sorry.

entries.text: 哦，对不起。
entries.source_text: 哦，对不起。

entries.text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!
entries.source_text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!

entries.text: 不行！我不会为谁收起我的枪！
entries.source_text: 不行！我不会为谁收起我的枪！

entries.text: You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law.# Put your weapon away. Don't draw it unless in self-defense and# you won't have a problem with us guards. Disobey the law and we# will return you to the lawless wasteland--dead or alive.
entries.source_text:
You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law.
# Put your weapon away. Don't draw it unless in self-defense and
# you won't have a problem with us guards. Disobey the law and we
# will return you to the lawless wasteland--dead or alive.

entries.text: 你最好规矩点，既然这里有法律，并且我执法。把你的武器收起来。除非你要自卫，不然不要拿出你的武器，这样你就不会与我们守卫有什么麻烦。不服从法律的，我们会送你回到无法律的废土上——无论生死。
entries.source_text: 你最好规矩点，既然这里有法律，并且我执法。把你的武器收起来。除非你要自卫，不然不要拿出你的武器，这样你就不会与我们守卫有什么麻烦。不服从法律的，我们会送你回到无法律的废土上——无论生死。

entries.text: Sure, since you put it that way.
entries.source_text: Sure, since you put it that way.

entries.text: 既然你这么说，那好吧。
entries.source_text: 既然你这么说，那好吧。

entries.text: Bite your laws!
entries.source_text: Bite your laws!

entries.text: 你的法律去死吧！
entries.source_text: 你的法律去死吧！

entries.text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.
entries.source_text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.

entries.text: 嗯，对于我无妨。不过你最好小心点。
entries.source_text: 嗯，对于我无妨。不过你最好小心点。

entries.text: Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If# you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your right# to go around armed. Just don't pull a knife or gun without just# cause. Have a good day.
entries.source_text:
Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If
# you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your right

entries.text: 问得好了。除非是自卫，否则不允许亮出武器。如果是你挑起的打斗，那是你的错。除此之外，你有权利带着武器。只要别在无正当理由的情况下把刀或枪拿出来。
entries.source_text: 问得好了。除非是自卫，否则不允许亮出武器。如果是你挑起的打斗，那是你的错。除此之外，你有权利带着武器。只要别在无正当理由的情况下把刀或枪拿出来。

entries.text: Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on# your head as a kid. No weapons.
entries.source_text:
Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on
# your head as a kid. No weapons.

entries.text: 嘿，你，不准拿出武器！我不管是不是你小时候你老妈把你头朝地摔到地上过。不准亮出武器。
entries.source_text: 嘿，你，不准拿出武器！我不管是不是你小时候你老妈把你头朝地摔到地上过。不准亮出武器。

entries.text: Hey! You! What are you doing sneaking around?
entries.source_text: Hey! You! What are you doing sneaking around?

entries.text: 嘿！你！你在附近偷偷摸摸的干什么？
entries.source_text: 嘿！你！你在附近偷偷摸摸的干什么？

entries.text: Nothing.
entries.source_text: Nothing.

entries.text: 没什么。
entries.source_text: 没什么。

entries.text: I'm not sneaking around. I just like to walk cautiously.
entries.source_text: I'm not sneaking around. I just like to walk cautiously.

entries.text: 我没有偷偷摸摸。我只是小心地走路而已。
entries.source_text: 我没有偷偷摸摸。我只是小心地走路而已。

entries.text: Uhhh.
entries.source_text: Uhhh.

entries.text: 呃。
entries.source_text: 呃。

entries.text: Whatever you're doing, don't do it in this town.
entries.source_text: Whatever you're doing, don't do it in this town.

entries.text: 不管你在做什么，别在城里这么干。
entries.source_text: 不管你在做什么，别在城里这么干。

entries.text: Hey! No shady characters in town! Get out of here before we throw you out!
entries.source_text: Hey! No shady characters in town! Get out of here before we throw you out!

entries.text: 嘿！名声不好的人不准进城！在我们赶你出去前滚出去。
entries.source_text: 嘿！名声不好的人不准进城！在我们赶你出去前滚出去。

entries.text: Well, uh, OK. Whatever. Just don't do anything out of line.
entries.source_text: Well, uh, OK. Whatever. Just don't do anything out of line.

entries.text: 嗯，好吧。随便你。只要别干什么越轨行为。
entries.source_text: 嗯，好吧。随便你。只要别干什么越轨行为。

entries.text: Thanks, bye.
entries.source_text: Thanks, bye.

entries.text: 谢谢，再见。
entries.source_text: 谢谢，再见。

entries.text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, sir.
entries.source_text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, sir.

entries.text: 当然。我以后不会再警告你的，先生。
entries.source_text: 当然。我以后不会再警告你的，先生。

entries.text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, ma'am.
entries.source_text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, ma'am.

entries.text: 当然。我以后不会再警告你的，女士。
entries.source_text: 当然。我以后不会再警告你的，女士。

entries.text: You'd better watch your step around here, because we'll be watching you.
entries.source_text: You'd better watch your step around here, because we'll be watching you.

entries.text: 你在这里最好注意你的言行，因为我会盯着你的。
entries.source_text: 你在这里最好注意你的言行，因为我会盯着你的。

entries.source_text: Welcome to Junktown. What can I do for you?

entries.source_text: 欢迎来到迦克镇。我有什么能帮你吗？

entries.text: Nothing, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks.

entries.source_text: 没什么，谢谢。

entries.text: What are you doing here? What is this place?
entries.source_text: What are you doing here? What is this place?

entries.source_text: 你在这里做什么？这里是什么地方？

entries.text: Where can I get some supplies?
entries.source_text: Where can I get some supplies?

entries.text: Wa-wa!
entries.source_text: Wa-wa!

entries.text: 哇—哇！
entries.source_text: 哇—哇！

I dunno about that. You might want to check with Killian.

entries.text: 我不知道。你可以去找基利安问问。他就在北面一点。就是这条路，清楚了吗？
entries.source_text: 我不知道。你可以去找基利安问问。他就在北面一点。就是这条路，清楚了吗？

entries.text: What does it look like? I'm a guard, and I'm keeping an eye out for# strangers like you. And this place is called Junktown. Hey, don't laugh.# I happen to like the name myself. We mostly do trading. Sometimes we trade# with those stuck up bastards from Hub. Hey, you're not from the Hub are you?

entries.text: 我看起来像什么？我是一个守卫，而且我就是专门留意你这类外人的。这里是一个叫迦克镇的地方。嘿，别笑。我恰好喜欢这个名字。我们主要是做贸易的。有些时候我们和从哈勃城来的那些混蛋商人交易。嘿，你不是从哈勃城来的吧？
entries.source_text: 我看起来像什么？我是一个守卫，而且我就是专门留意你这类外人的。这里是一个叫迦克镇的地方。嘿，别笑。我恰好喜欢这个名字。我们主要是做贸易的。有些时候我们和从哈勃城来的那些混蛋商人交易。嘿，你不是从哈勃城来的吧？

entries.text: It's going to cause me some severe mental trauma. Later.

entries.text: Oh, heck. The place for that is Darkwater's. Killian runs it.# It's a little to the north. Killian has the best supplies in town.

entries.text: Uh, no. Sorry, lady. I got work to do here.
